nit: rephrase
Done
Which property below represents Peak? Or is PeakPower a different object?
It's in interface `xyz.openbmc_project.Common.Statistics`. Updated the commit message with get call on that interface.
This and the one above have same pathnames?
Yes.
How is that not causing a problem?
Because class NvidiaGpuPowerPeakReading adds Common.Statistics interface while class NvidiaGpuPowerSensor adds Sensor.Value interface.
Can we reuse power req/resp structures?
Done
Can we reuse power encode/decode APIs?
I have reused decode API. We can't reuse encode API as it is different command code that GetPowerDraw.
Isn't the difference just the cmd enum? That can be a function param and you can reuse encode API?
Done.
PDI feedback at https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/78348 needs to be addressed
Replied to opened comments. Awaiting responses from Maintainers.

I agree with your comments on the PDI patch. Also, not sure if we want to define a Common.Statistics which seems like an alternative to telemetry, I see following options:

1) Object can be in the sensors/power/<sensor_name> namespace with a well-known name (peak_). The same would have to be handled in bmxweb.
2) Define new sensor/power/peak/<sensor_name> namespace.
3) OEM PDI.

Can you please start discussion on Discord fans-and-sensors?
Done
Don't think we need a struct for this.

I have used struct to maintain the state variables (eid, mctpRequester, dbusInterface etc) that are needed. If we don't use struct then we would be passing a reference to the data (eid, mctpRequester, dbusInterface etc) as the first argument to the all the free functions, which is essentially what struct does for us here.
I meant reuse power sensor struct
We can't do that. class NvidiaGpuPowerPeakReading uses Common.Statistics interface while class NvidiaGpuPowerSensor uses Sensor.Value interface to publish sensor values.
@haghera@nvidia.com suggestion from Patrick was to get community consensus on the right PDI approach - please send email on the mailing list with details.
Also to be clear, this isn't about Patrick, this isn't implemented correctly to Redfish which requires a reset.
Done

Implementing a Reset requires issuing a NSM command to the GPU on demand exposed via dbus api, infra for which does not existing in nvidiagpusensors app yet. Should we add support for the PATCH operation in separate patch and only implement GET operation with this patch?
Updated the commit message with the current limitation.
Couple questions and a legit CI fail.
Should this be _Peak_Power_0?
`name` is used to derive dbus Object path and we need to put the telemetry report interface at the same object path as Sensor.Value and hence it has to be `Power_0`.
Nit: does the nsame statisticsInterface still make sense? We aren't using that interface and are using Telemetry instead. Side Note: Let's abandon the Common.Statistics PDI patch.
Done

sorry for the dumb question:

Why is this PeakReading stuff only implemented for Nvidia gpu sensor?

It sounds like a feature that could potentially apply to other sensors which store peak readings internally. It could even be computed based on observed values for sensors which do not store peak reading internally.

I did not find anything in the redfish spec saying that it must be a hardware backed value.

So i am kind of surprised there is no common code, can someone explain to me 😊
